assumptions: Recognition sites are REBASE's, as the bundled table holds them.
limits: Counts sites; it does not say whether a cut is blocked or stars.
bio.jane/contract.question: How many times does each enzyme cut this molecule?

description: Per-enzyme cut counts on the open plasmid (the EcoRI² superscript-badge numbers).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

enzymes.description: enzyme names to scope the scan to — resolved against the bundled cut catalog (REBASE spellings; smaller than the REBASE dossier the editor shows). Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

name: enzyme_cut_counts

counts.description: enzyme → cut-count map; an enzyme with no sites is present with 0, never omitted

cutters.description: how many of the enzymes cut at least once

single.description: how many cut EXACTLY once: the enzymes that linearise this molecule

total.description: total cuts across every enzyme asked about

zero_cutters.description: how many were scanned for and have no site here
